title: Master of Science in Biomedical Sciences
institution: Mohammed Bin Rashid University of Medicine and Health Sciences (MBRU)
about: MBRU's two-year, full-time Master of Science in Biomedical Sciences in Dubai is accepting applications for 2027-28 from October 12, 2026 until July 12, 2027, with interviews on July 19, 2027. Early submissions receive priority.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in a biological sciences discipline with a minimum cGPA of 3.00/4.00 (2.5-2.99 may receive conditional admission)
English proficiency (IELTS or TOEFL; TOEFL iBT minimum 80)
Applications only through the online portal
card_alt: EduCut Connect card for the Master of Science in Biomedical Sciences at Mohammed Bin Rashid University of Medicine and Health Sciences (MBRU), Dubai, United Arab Emirates; deadline 12 Jul 2027. The photo shows the Museum of the Future in Dubai.
